The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by suspension geometry camber-adjusting shim stack and specific design requirements.

commonFailures: Fatigue crack at thread-shank transition - prevented by larger fillet R0.5->1.5mm + cold rolling — critical for suspension geometry camberadjusting performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Camber Adjustment Shim suitable for Suspension geometry camber-adjusting shim stack?
faq.a: Titanium Camber Adjustment Shim uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address suspension operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Camber Adjustment Shim?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Camber Adjustment Shim is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for suspension geometry camberadjusting requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Camber Adjustment Shim require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. suspension geometry camberadjusting components require DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for suspension geometry camberadjusting application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Camber Adjustment Shim shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Camber Adjustment Shim includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet suspension geometry camberadjusting specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
